title.en: Printed-row question: What does the selection guide shortlist for a small site
title.zh: 先看已印出的行：选型指南给小型工地列了哪些泵

description.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. B500S-83D, then Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, Tractor-Driven 4100, and the rural diesel pump named in the recommendation sentence. Read it in the Xingtai table. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints that shortlist for a compact pump on a small building site. Taken from the printed row: B500S-83D is 280 kg and 5 m / 5 m. Keep this cell as published. The others print about 400–1300 kg and longer catalogue distances. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Power type still splits the list: 380 V or 15 kW on the electric units, tractor drive or 17 kW diesel on the other two.
description.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。B500S-83D，然后是电动15、电动10系列、拖拉机带动4100，以及推荐句里点名的农村柴油泵。邢台河北品锦机械把这份短名单印给小型建筑工地的紧凑泵。B500S-83D 是 280 kg、5 m / 5 m。其余几台大约 400–1300 kg，目录距离更长。动力仍然把名单分开：电动机型要 380 V 或 15 kW，另外两台是拖拉机带动或 17 kW 柴油。

body.en: The reference page “How to Calculate the Density of Slurries: Formula and Examples” uses “Example - Calculating Slurry Density” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. B500S-83D first for 5 m, then Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, Tractor-Driven 4100, and the rural diesel pump named in the same sentence. Keep this cell as published. B500S-83D is 280 kg and 5 m / 5 m. Taken from the printed row: “400–1300 kg” in the guide’s rationale covers Electric 10 Series at 400 kg, Electric 15 at 450 kg, the rural diesel at 800 kg and the 4100 at 1300 kg. Read it in the Xingtai table. Those frames are 2300–3300 kg with much longer distance cells. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Name which shortlist window you measured, including power. Keep this cell as published. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print. Taken from the printed row: Use that URL rather than a trailer such as Diesel 30 when the 17 kW window fits. Read it in the Xingtai table. No. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/slurry-density-calculate-d_1188.html
body.zh: 来源页《How to Calculate the Density of Slurries: Formula and Examples》用“例子计算密度”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。旁边那一台不在这句话里。5 米先看 B500S-83D，然后是电动15、电动10系列、拖拉机带动4100，以及同一句里点名的农村柴油泵。这一格照已印出的读：同一份指南里的中型建筑是电动40、电动50和柴油40 / 50。那些机架是 2300–3300 kg，距离格长得多。管路离开紧凑窗口后，就换问题。不要因为场地看起来不大就把电动40叫成小型工地泵。目录里已经写着：推荐文字把它和 4100 写在一起。产品页在 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump。17 kW 窗口对得上时用这个地址，而不是柴油30那种拖泵。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/slurry-density-calculate-d_1188.html

heading.en: Slurry Density and Specific Weight Calculator

body.en: “Slurry Density and Specific Weight Calculator” is an outline label from “How to Calculate the Density of Slurries: Formula and Examples”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Read it in the Xingtai table. B500S-83D, then Electric 15, Electric 10 Series, Tractor-Driven 4100, and the rural diesel pump named in the recommendation sentence. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The others print about 400–1300 kg and longer catalogue distances. Keep this cell as published. Quote the model cell in an order, not the range alone. Taken from the printed row: Once the pipe leaves the compact windows, change question. Read it in the Xingtai table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The recommendation text names it beside the 4100. Keep this cell as published. The guide says first for 5 m short-reach sand and small stone. Taken from the printed row: Spraying is a different selection-guide question.
body.zh: “密度比重量计算器”是《How to Calculate the Density of Slurries: Formula and Examples》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。按邢台表上的原文理解：B500S-83D，然后是电动15、电动10系列、拖拉机带动4100，以及推荐句里点名的农村柴油泵。邢台河北品锦机械把这份短名单印给小型建筑工地的紧凑泵。B500S-83D 是 280 kg、5 m / 5 m。其余几台大约 400–1300 kg，目录距离更长。动力仍然把名单分开：电动机型要 380 V 或 15 kW，另外两台是拖拉机带动或 17 kW 柴油。旁边那一台不在这句话里。请点名你量到的是短名单里的哪一扇窗口，并写上动力。这一格照已印出的读：指南说的是 5 米短距离砂与小石时优先。更长的管子从同一份短名单的其他型号开始。

heading.en: Specific Gravity of Water based Slurries

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Specific Gravity of Water based Slurries” from “How to Calculate the Density of Slurries: Formula and Examples”, then stays with the cells already published. Taken from the printed row: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints that shortlist for a compact pump on a small building site. Read it in the Xingtai table. Power type still splits the list: 380 V or 15 kW on the electric units, tractor drive or 17 kW diesel on the other two. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Medium building in the same guide is Electric 40, Electric 50 and Diesel 40 / 50. Keep this cell as published. Do not call Electric 40 a small-site pump because the plot looks modest. Taken from the printed row: Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. Its product page exists at /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Longer pipes start elsewhere on the same shortlist.
body.zh: 本节保留《How to Calculate the Density of Slurries: Formula and Examples》的标题“比重力水”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。目录里已经写着：指南理由里的“400–1300 kg”覆盖电动10系列 400 kg、电动15 450 kg、农村柴油泵 800 kg 和 4100 的 1300 kg。下单时引用型号格，不要只引用这个范围。按邢台表上的原文理解：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。旁边那一台不在这句话里。不包括。喷涂是选型指南里的另一个问题。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Example - Calculating Slurry Density” — Why is the rural diesel in the sentence but easy to miss?
question.zh: “例子计算密度”旁边仍要印着的是什么：为什么农村柴油泵在句子里却容易漏？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The recommendation text names it beside the 4100. Its product page exists at /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump. Use that URL rather than a trailer such as Diesel 30 when the 17 kW window fits.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。推荐文字把它和 4100 写在一起。产品页在 /products/rural-diesel-concrete-pump。17 kW 窗口对得上时用这个地址，而不是柴油30那种拖泵。

question.en: “Slurry Density and Specific Weight Calculator” does not change the check: Is B500S-83D always first?
question.zh: “密度比重量计算器”不改这一问：B500S-83D 总是第一吗？

answer.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. The guide says first for 5 m short-reach sand and small stone. Longer pipes start elsewhere on the same shortlist.
answer.zh: 按邢台表上的原文理解：指南说的是 5 米短距离砂与小石时优先。更长的管子从同一份短名单的其他型号开始。

question.en: Does the shortlist include a sprayer, once the outline says “Specific Gravity of Water based Slurries”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“比重力水”时，短名单包括喷涂机吗？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: No. Spraying is a different selection-guide question.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：不包括。喷涂是选型指南里的另一个问题。
